title: McMoneagle tells Jesse that humans may be turning into the ETs

tellings.quote: he said that I think we might be turning into these etss or something they might be sort of prompting us to turn into some of them

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he once spoke by phone with Joseph McMoneagle, a man known as a remote viewer, meaning someone who tries to describe distant places or things using the mind alone. According to Michels, sometime in the 2020s McMoneagle told him that humans might be turning into the ETs, the extraterrestrials, or that the visitors might be nudging us to become like them. If true, it would mean the beings people report are, in some sense, our own future.
